- Right green square at cols 21-23

The green squares are at the same positions as before. So RIGHT didn't move anything this time.
Wait, but earlier when I pressed RIGHT x3, the right green square moved from cols 13-14 to cols 21-23. Now when I press RIGHT, nothing moves. This suggests that the green squares can only move when they're not at their target positions, or there's some other condition.
Let me check the last_action_result to see if the board changed.

Let me check what changed by comparing the before and after frames.
Actually, I think the issue is that I need to click a green square to select it before moving. When both green squares have 8 pixels, neither is "active" for movement. I need to click one to make it the target for movement.
Let me try clicking the left green square and then pressing RIGHT.
